title: eupatorium mairei var. heterophyllum
intro: Eupatorium mairei var. heterophyllum, commonly known as the Brazilian Joseolea or Eupatorium heterophyllum, is a plant species within the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Brazil, for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Eupatorium mairei var. heterophyllum include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
